name: pixel-inspector
description: A Chrome extension for inspecting advertising and analytics pixels as you browse.

scripts.package:extension: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cd extension && zip -qr ../dist/pixel-inspector-0.1.3.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' 'README.md' 'store-listing.md' 'store-assets/*' && cd .. && zip -q dist/pixel-inspector-0.1.3.zip LICENSE NOTICE
